messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: reserved-pool 'resv-prod-west' reached 100% GPU utilization. queue_length=842, avg_wait=12.4s, throttle_rate=45% — autoscaler attempted scale, received 403 from cloud-api (quota_exceeded).
ellen-oncall: Acknowledged. Opening incident bridge now. tagging @miguel-sre and @ben-runtime. Need customer impact ASAP. :phone:
miguel-sre: Looking at metrics — spike started ~4132109600. sustained allocations from a long-running job. autoscaler logs show 'scale_limit_reached' followed by repeated 403s. Cloud quota for GPUs in us-west2 appears to be maxed for our account.
ben-runtime: autoscaler tried to spin up 4 nodes at 4132109635, calls to cloud failed with: 
```
HTTP 403 Forbidden: quotaExceeded: GPU quota (nvidia-t4) exceeded for project redwood-prod-uswest.
request id: af3b-11e6-9fd2
```
lee-support: Customer impact — telemetry shows elevated tail latencies and 429s for two enterprise tenants: OrchidBank (reserved_id=rb-3201) and GreenfieldPay (reserved_id=gf-1109). OrchidBank had 18% of requests queued >30s. GreenfieldPay saw 11% failed token requests (429). Both contacted via alerting but no outbound comms yet.
jordan-acct: I'll prep a short note for OrchidBank and GreenfieldPay explaining we're on it. Please include ETA and mitigation steps.
dina-telemetry: Noise source: tenant 'research-runner' has a runaway batch session pinned to 6 GPUs for ~2.5h, constant token generation loop. Confirming session id: s-9c4f. It's not on a reserved contract — looks like shared-tenant hogging resv pool due to faulty routing.
miguel-sre: Proposing immediate mitigations: 1) Evict non-reserved low-priority sessions from resv-prod-west 2) Temporarily disable scheduled batch jobs routing to reserved pool 3) Enable emergency burst to shared pools for enterprise tenants 4) Request cloud quota increase (but that's slow). Who can run evict?
ellen-oncall: Ben, can runtime run evict + short-term manual scale? I'll authorize emergency burst to shared pool for the two impacted tenants.
ben-runtime: Running dry-run now, then evict low-priority. Command: 
```
redwoodctl pool evict --pool resv-prod-west --filter "priority:low AND session_age>30m" --dry-run
```
ben-runtime: dry-run shows ~42 sessions matched (est 9 GPUs freed). Executing now.
deploy-bot: evict job queued (job id: evict-4132109890). Logs will stream to /var/log/redwood/evict-4132109890.log
ben-runtime: Evict completed. Freed ~10 GPUs. Queue length dropped to 540, avg_wait=8.2s. Still above SLO for OrchidBank.
ellen-oncall: Enabling emergency burst: routing enterprise reserved traffic to shared-backup-west for OrchidBank and GreenfieldPay. This is a temporary policy with strict throttling for non-reserved.
miguel-sre: Added throttles for non-enterprise: max_concurrent=200 per-minute and reduced batch window. Should reduce noisy neighbor impact.
dina-telemetry: After evict + burst, OrchidBank queue down to 23 requests queued >30s (from 152). GreenfieldPay error rate falling to 3%. Good immediate improvement.
jordan-acct: Messaging draft: "We observed elevated latency and queueing earlier today due to capacity pressure in our reserved pool. We've applied emergency mitigations (eviction of non-critical sessions and temporary routing to a backup pool). Impact reduced; we expect full recovery in ~30-60m. We will follow up with a root cause and preventive actions." Approve?
ellen-oncall: Send it. Make sure to add a contact and escalation path.
ben-runtime: Follow-up: found a runaway session owner contact info in session metadata: owner=alice.research@vendorcorp.com. Support is reaching out to request immediate termination of their job. If they refuse, will force-terminate next.
lee-support: Reached out to vendorcorp contact; they said they triggered a long experiment but didn't realize routing to reserved pool. They agreed to terminate. Waiting confirmation.
miguel-sre: Long-term actions (to track): 1) Harden autoscaler to fallback to shared pool on quota errors 2) Automation: preempt low-priority sessions earlier when resv pool > 85% 3) Quota monitoring and automated increase request when trending 4) Add per-tenant job duration caps for shared routing.
ellen-oncall: Creating incident ticket and assigning postmortem to @miguel-sre. Also assign action item to @ben-runtime to add a forced-eject playbook.
dina-telemetry: Logged incident metrics snapshot and exported dashboards to incident board: https://console.redwood.internal/incident/4132109876
ben-runtime: Quick note — autoscaler failed to retry because error handling treated 403 as terminal. I'll open PR to make 403 retriable with exponential backoff and fallback options.
jordan-acct: Sent customer notes to OrchidBank + GreenfieldPay. Both replied appreciating the quick mitigation; OrchidBank asked for timeline for preventing recurrence. I'll schedule follow-up.
ellen-oncall: Status check — queue at 120, avg_wait=4.6s, OrchidBank errors back to baseline. We'll keep bridge open for +1h then transition to async follow-ups. Final short post-incident summary in 30m. Great triage team. :thumbsup:
